notes: A pause from the earbuds now leaves the session, the wake lock and the background hold alive, exactly as a pause from the lock screen already did, so the next press from the buds has something to land on.
A play press from a headset has its own branch in the app’s key handler instead of falling through a catch-all, and it cancels the clock that would park the session before the song is started.
Pause from every door - the app, the lock screen, the notification, the earbuds - now goes through one function, so the two halves of a transport press cannot be wired differently again.
